description: Read the account’s live compute-meter usage (RPC-backed, account-scoped — no notebook). Returns the five-hour and weekly quota windows as percentages, their reset times, and a per-action table of what still has quota. status=disabled when the account has no meter. Use it to check headroom before a long batch of questions or generations.
name: get_usage

data.description: The tool payload on success. The exact shape depends on the tool.

error.description: Human-readable error message, present only when success is false.
